_about: Claims Microsoft Entra ID returns in the ID token after a successful login. Scopes requested by this app: openid profile email. Values below are PLACEHOLDERS (typical Entra v2.0 token). The exact set depends on tenant and app registration, so confirm with a real login.

id_token_claims.sub: <pairwise user id, stable per user per app>
id_token_claims.oid: <user object id in the tenant, same across apps>
id_token_claims.name: Pranto Bhowmik

validated_by_authlib.iss: must equal the issuer in the discovery document
validated_by_authlib.aud: must equal this app's client id
validated_by_authlib.exp_iat: checked, with 120 seconds of clock leeway
validated_by_authlib.nonce: must equal the value stored at login
validated_by_authlib.state_and_pkce: state checked on callback, PKCE verifier sent in the token exchange

how_this_app_uses_them.iss + sub: identity key, stored in user_identities (unique together). Never use email to identify a user
how_this_app_uses_them.name: users.display_name, refreshed on every login
how_this_app_uses_them.email or preferred_username: users.email, refreshed on every login (email is not guaranteed to be present or verified)

caveats.email: Optional in Entra. Can be missing, and is not guaranteed verified, so it is never used to match accounts
caveats.preferred_username: Display hint only. It can change and is not a stable id
caveats.guest_users: External or guest accounts may add an 'idp' claim and a different iss/tid
caveats.tokens_not_kept: The access and ID tokens are discarded after the callback

obtainable_with_more_configuration.graph_requirements: needs the User.Read scope (and an access token, which this app does not currently keep)
